name: SaaS Admin renews temporary password for a site manager
title: SC-03-07-01 SaaS Admin renews temporary password for a site manager
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a registered site with a site manager
When SaaS Admin triggers "Şifre Yenile" for the site
Then a new cryptographically secure temporary password (pattern: SP-[A-Z0-9]{4}-PASS) is generated
And the site admin record is updated with mustChange[redacted] the credentials dialog is presented to the SaaS Admin for delivery to the site manager
